info.name: PhotoCraft integration
info.summary: Edit photos and Photoshop files in Nextcloud with PhotoCraft
info.description:
Open a photo or a layered image in Files with **Edit in PhotoCraft** and work on it right in the browser: layers, masks, adjustment layers, selections, brushes, retouching, filters and text, with Photoshop (PSD, PSB) files as well as PNG, JPEG, TIFF, WebP, HEIC and camera raw files.
- **Save** writes a layered file (PSD, PSB, PhotoCraft) straight back to Nextcloud, which keeps the previous state as a file version. A flat image that gained layers asks for a name and folder first, as in Photoshop. - **Save As** and **Export** store a file in any folder you pick. - Read-only files open normally; saving offers a copy. - If someone else changes the file while you have it open, you choose whether to replace their version or save a copy. - Optionally, clicking an image in Files opens it in PhotoCraft instead of the viewer.
PhotoCraft runs entirely in your browser as WebAssembly. Files go only between your browser and your Nextcloud, and the server needs no extra software.
This is a community integration based on [PhotoCraft](https://github.com/storytold/photocraft) by the ArtCraft team, an open-source, Rust-native image editor. It embeds a build of PhotoCraft and is not made or endorsed by the ArtCraft team.
**Requirements:** a browser with WebGPU or WebGL2, and a web server that serves `.wasm` files as `application/wasm` (Nextcloud's own Apache and nginx configurations do).
info.author: Britton Couchman
